description: This file defines a custom Robolectric test runner for the AnySoftKeyboard project, extending RobolectricTestRunner to add specific setup and teardown behavior for tests, including test grouping and RxJava schedulers management.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardRobolectricTestRunner
classes.description: Custom Robolectric test runner that adds grouping and setup for testing the AnySoftKeyboard app.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardRobolectricTestLifeCycle
classes.description: Inner class defining the test lifecycle hooks for setup and teardown during tests.

methods.name: AnySoftKeyboardRobolectricTestRunner
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test runner and adds test grouping filters.

methods.name: getTestLifecycleClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for the test lifecycle, customized for this runner.

methods.name: beforeTest
methods.description: Hook executed before each test, sets up schedulers and logs start.

methods.name: afterTest
methods.description: Hook executed after each test, logs completion and destroys schedulers.
